		has_owner = yes
	is_capital = yes
	owner ?= {
		religion = religion:hellenism_religion
		has_variable = oe_eln_atlantic_pantheon_unlocked
	}
	}

		if = {
			limit = {
				location = { has_owner = yes }
			}
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {

					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_eln_built_atlantic_pantheon value = 1 }
					add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
				add_religious_influence_if_valid = { VALUE = 15 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_eln_temple_atlantic_pantheon_maint = {
			icon_type = building_type
